Groundwater pumps can be used as infinite water sources. These pumps can only access groundwater, which requires special placement, they do not access water source blocks.

For a pump to work, it needs to be placed on Y coordinate 70 or lower, and it needs to be placed on porous blocks, like dirt, sand or gravel. The pump will check a 3x3 area, four blocks down, and if at least half the blocks it detects are considered porous, it can operate.

The pumps come in two variants, steam-powered ones which use steam and create low-pressure steam, and electric ones. Electric pumps are substantially faster than steam-powered ones.
